decisions.reason: The offshore vessel management service fits the firm's maritime capabilities and the growing offshore energy market, so despite limited later website evidence it is strategically worth retaining.
Crew and corporate travel management was likely hit hard by the 2020-2021 travel disruption and is less core than vessel operations, making it the most likely service to be withdrawn.

An online vessel information portal is a scalable digital add-on that supports customer retention and operational transparency, so a large transport-support firm would usually keep it unless uptake was clearly weak.
A mobile vessel performance app matches industry demand for efficiency, monitoring and digitalization, so it is likely to stay in the portfolio as a strategic support tool.
